title: Face Sculpt #279 (일본 · 아이돌 · 당황한 · 서큐버스 · 정면 · 유형 고유 메이크업 · P100 · 혼합 금속 추 10개/귀 1구멍 · 슬롯 이마 펜던트+코-귀 체인 · 헤나 · 스티커)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Early 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful, seductive adult woman, mid 20s, a succubus brought to life: pale skin with real visible pores and a faint dusky flush on the cheekbones, two small, glossy, black, curved demon horns rising from her forehead at the hairline, long straight deep burgundy hair swept back behind both ears. Her eyes are large, sharp, heavy-lidded and seductive, with a long upturned wing of deep crimson liner, in violet contact lenses with vertical slit pupils, both eyes the same, fully opaque, with bright catchlights, under thin, sharp, high-arched black brows. Her lips are full, lush and glossy in a deep wine-black-red, with a pronounced cupid's bow, closed in a faint knowing smirk. High, sharp cheekbones, a slender nose and a defined jaw. A dangerous, seductive, confident gaze straight into the camera. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain and a soft sheen of natural oils, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real woman's face, not an illustration, not a render.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about fifty-six in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; two small rings wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; five small ring or studs on the chin; on each ear, one large healed opening in the earlobe holding a very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above it sit fourteen pieces above the lobe: seven classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, four studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and three in the conch and tragus; eight small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. A forehead pendant: a fine gold chain runs along the centre parting of her hair and ends in a teardrop gem pendant resting at the middle of her forehead. A nose-to-ear chain: a fine chain swags from the ring on her left nostril wing across the cheek, well below the eye and clear of the lips, up to a hook at the top of her left ear. The left and right sides are balanced. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. Stickers: five tiny glow-in-the-dark heart and star stickers are scattered flat on the skin of the lower cheeks and the jawline below the cheekbone studs, clear of the piercings, the eyes and the lips. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of this iron ring, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly ten separate massive weights, each of a different shape and a different metal, all of them rough, hammered, matte and unpolished, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal as the weight: on the left ear dull pewter-grey tin a barrel-shaped weight on a shortest chain, tarnished dark silver a round bell on a shortest chain, oxidized dark copper a pyramid-shaped lump on a short chain, dull blue-grey lead a ship's anchor on a short chain, blackened cast iron a teardrop-shaped sinker on a medium chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a miniature anvil on a long chain, dull dark brass a square-sided cowbell on a long chain, dark patinated bronze a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a longer chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a hammer head on a longer chain, dark patinated bronze a cube-shaped block on a longest chain; on the right ear oxidized dark copper a hammer head on a shortest chain, tarnished dark silver a teardrop-shaped sinker on a shortest chain, dull blue-grey lead a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a short chain, dull pewter-grey tin a ship's anchor on a short chain, dark patinated bronze a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a medium chain, blackened cast iron a cube-shaped block on a long chain, dull dark brass a round bell on a long chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a pyramid-shaped lump on a longer chain, dull dark brass a square-sided cowbell on a longer chain, oxidized dark copper a miniature anvil on a longest chain. On each ear the single iron ring carries all the weights, hanging in a staggered cluster on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because all the load is carried by one opening, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real blackened steel set with small clear diamonds, one-colour, restrained, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal in mixed materials (lead, tin, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass and iron), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
